0.desc:
Lemon Tree Punch is a captivating hybrid strain crafted by Greenpoint Seeds, born from the flavorful cross of Lemon Tree and Purple Punch. This exceptional blend marries the sweet-and-sour zest of Lemon Tree with the fruity fragrance of Purple Punch, resulting in a rich and complex flavor profile. Strong notes of lemon, grape, and berry dominate the aroma, intertwined with subtle hints of diesel and earthy undertones. Depending on the phenotype, some expressions may highlight the grape and berry flavors, while others emphasize the citrusy essence, offering a unique experience with each taste.
The strain's primary terpenes include Limonene, Humulene, Myrcene, Linalool, and Bisabolol, contributing to its multifaceted flavors and effects. Limonene imparts a bright citrus flavor and is associated with uplifting mood and energy. Humulene and Myrcene add earthy and herbal nuances, promoting a sense of calm and relaxation. Linalool introduces gentle floral notes, enhancing the overall aromatic experience. Together, these terpenes create a harmonious balance that is both invigorating and soothing.
Lemon Tree Punch offers a balanced effect that is both stimulating and comforting. Users report that in small doses, it may boost mood and increase motivation, providing a gentle cerebral uplift that enhances focus and creativity. When consumed in larger quantities, the invigorating sensation shifts into a mellow relaxation, soothing the mind and fostering a peaceful state. Despite the calming body effects, the mind remains clear and functional. This versatile hybrid is ideal for those seeking to elevate their spirits during the day or unwind in the evening, making it a great all-day choice.
Strain Type: Hybrid
Lineage: [Lemon Tree] x [Purple Punch]
Breeder: Greenpoint Seeds
Primary Terpene Profile: Limonene, Humulene, Myrcene, Linalool, Bisabolol
Top Reported Strain Effects: Cerebral, Relaxed, Focused, Calm
Top Report Strain Flavors: Lemon, Grape, Berry, Diesel, Earth

3.desc: The Strain: Max AC stands as a pinnacle of hybrid ingenuity, brought to life by Greenpoint Genetics through an inspired cross of MAC 1 and Animal Cookies. The spicy, peppery nuances of caryophyllene interlace with the rich, earthy foundation of myrcene and humulene, creating a multi-layered taste that is both robust and satisfying. Bisabolol rounds out the experience with subtle floral hints, adding an elegant softness that completes the symphony of flavors. The result is an immersive, gourmet experience that dances between tangy citrus, spicy earthiness, and delicate floral sweetness. As the high unfolds, Max AC sets the stage for a state of inspired focus and tranquil contentment. The initial rush sparks an elevated mood, fueling creative thoughts and a sense of invigorated drive ideal for sketching out new ideas or engaging in reflective planning. Gradually, a soothing calm pervades the body, nurturing a feeling of quiet satisfaction and mental clarity. Max AC's dynamic progression from an energizing lift to a serene, grounding calm invites you to embrace an active, yet reflective state, transforming your day into an exploration of both creative vibrancy and peaceful repose.Strain Type: Hybrid Lineage: [Mac 1] x [Animal Cookies] Breeder: Greenpoint Genetics Primary Terpene Profile: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Humulene, Myrcene, Bisabolol Top Reported Strain Effects: Calm, Contented, Motivated, Uplifted, Peaceful Top Reported Strain Flavors: Citrus, Creamy, Spicy, Earthy, Herbal, Floral The Product: Uncured fresh frozen plant material created into a frosting/peanut-butter like substance that is high in terpene content allowing maximum flavor and effect. 154.desc:
Dr. Funkenstein, also known as "Dr. Funk," is an indica-dominant hybrid strain cultivated by Royal King Seeds. Born from the legendary union of Blueberry and Bubba Kush, this strain captures the best qualities of its renowned parentage. Dr. Funkenstein offers a flavorful journey that delights the palate with a blend of sweet berry notes and earthy sharpness, reflecting its rich genetic heritage.

The strain's primary terpene profile includes Myrcene, Pinene, and Caryophyllene, contributing to its distinctive flavors and effects. Myrcene enhances the sweet, fruity aroma and promotes a sense of relaxation. Pinene introduces subtle pine undertones that can uplift and refresh the senses, while Caryophyllene adds a spicy hint that elevates the overall taste experience. This harmonious combination results in a flavor profile featuring berry, blueberry, cheesy, and sweet notes that make each encounter with Dr. Funkenstein uniquely enjoyable.

Dr. Funkenstein is celebrated for inducing a multifaceted experience that pleasantly envelops both mind and body. Users often report an onset of euphoria and cerebral stimulation, fostering feelings of happiness and creativity. As the journey continues, it gradually transitions into a powerful body sensation that promotes deep relaxation and a laid-back state. This progression may lead to increased appetite and a gentle inclination toward introspection, accompanied by a soothing, sleepy feeling. Drawing from its Blueberry and Bubba Kush lineage, Dr. Funkenstein offers a well-rounded experience that balances uplifting mental effects with calming physical relaxation.

Strain Type: Hybrid
Lineage: [Blueberry] x [Bubba Kush]
Breeder: Royal King Seeds
Primary Terpene Profile: Myrcene, Pinene, Caryophyllene
Top Reported Strain Effects: Happy, Creative, Hungry, Sleepy, Euphoric

155.desc:
Ghost OG, a cut of OG Kush, is a hybrid strain loved for its balanced cerebral and body effects.  Often described as simultaneously potent and non-intrusive, Ghost OG has won itself Cup awards and renown among consumers. 

Despite its intimidating name, Ghost OG is actually a mellow, relaxing strain that’s great for recreational use. This is the strain to go to when you’re having a Netflix-and-Chill day at home. As an indica-dominant hybrid, Ghost OG can melt all your worries, stressors, and anxieties away and replace them with a soothing, peaceful experience. There’s nothing better than watching your favorite comedy or listening to your favorite album than with Ghost OG in the mix.

Even though the high of Ghost OG is noticeable, it’s rarely considered to be too overpowering or overwhelming. This hybrid comes with moderate THC levels that are suitable for all smoking levels. The overall experience of Ghost OG is zen, euphoric, and giggly. This hybrid produces a happy high that veers on the cerebral side in the early stages.

The second wave of Ghost OG shows its indica side. The brain and body enter a state of pure relaxation. This can help combat feelings of pain, anxiety, nausea, and inflammation. Any discomfort in the body with gradually fade away as you continue to smoke Ghost OG on the couch. It also might be a good idea to keep snacks around as this strain promotes the munchies.

Top Reported Strain Effects: Relaxed, Happy, Euphoric

157.desc:
The Black Maple strain is a unique hybrid strain that combines the genetic traits of the Dulce De Uva and Sherbanger strains. As a hybrid variety, it has inherited qualities from both its parent strains, resulting in a unique genetic makeup that gives it distinct features, effects, and characteristics.

Dulce De Uva, a cross of Grape Pie and OG Kush, is cherished for its sweet, grape-like scent and deeply relaxing stone. Sherbanger, the other parent of Black Maple, is known for its rich, creamy flavor and dense, frosty buds. By combining the two, Bloom Seeds has created a stellar hybrid that embodies all the qualities of an elite strain.

The flavor of this strain is just as delightful, coating the mouth with the sweet flavors of blueberry ice cream and exotic spices. The taste lingers for several minutes, making for a pleasant experience that any cannabis user is sure to love.

158.desc:
Animal Star Cookies is a balanced hybrid strain expertly crafted by Greenpoint Seeds, born from the union of Animal Cookies and Stardawg. This unique blend combines the soothing qualities of an indica with the uplifting effects of a sativa, offering a gentle yet powerful experience that calms the body and elevates the spirit. With its harmonious nature, Animal Star Cookies helps users relax and find themselves in a state of emotional well-being.
The strain's rich terpene profile contributes to its complex flavors and effects. Sweet and earthy notes are complemented by hints of vanilla and nutty undertones, creating a delightful and nuanced taste experience. As you pull apart each dazzling little nugget, aromas of spicy peppery menthol and sweet sugary grapes are released, intensifying in potency the more that you toke. The flavor is of sweet fruity plums, fresh grapes and a punch of spicy menthol. The Pavé high will hit you pretty quickly after you exhale, taking on your brain before taking hold of your body. The Hawaiian-bred Skunkdog Bx1, a staple strain on the islands, is known for its ability to withstand high humidity and thrive in even the wettest climates. This powerhouse male amplifies the acrid funk of Headband and ChemD and adds hardiness to the cross. While the flowering time runs longer than average, the payoff is worth the wait – a potent, complex expression of sour, skunk, and chem exploding from every bud.

187.desc:
Ice Cream Nana x Strawberry Runtz

-------------

This strain is part of Breakwater's Pheno Hunt project. Short for “Phenotype Hunt,” a Pheno Hunt is the search for the best possible version of a strain. When we acquire seeds of a compelling strain, we grow multiple plants to maturity. Each plant is a unique physical expression or phenotype of its genetic makeup (just like children from the same parents can be quite different). We evaluate each phenotype for traits such as flower size, plant structure, aromas, effects, and potency. In a successful Pheno Hunt, the most promising candidate will become a mother plant for a new strain of Breakwater Premium Flower.

With this new patient-facing project, we're inviting you to participate in this process and give us your feedback on which pheno is the best fit for our patients!

193.desc: Pie Dough Bx1 x Grape Pie Wedding Crasher ------------- Breakwater Small Batch is a series of limited releases created to bring you closer to our strain selection process. This project gives you the opportunity to explore strains that are still being evaluated for large scale production. Some of these strains may even return to our menu. ------------- Though pheno-hunting is always something of a lottery, we often seem to hit the jackpot with Crystal Rose Seed Co.’s genetics. Producing winners like Pie Eyed, Wave Runners, and Watermelon Otai, their complex, one-of-a-kind crosses always have us coming back for more, and Grape Crepe is no different. Prior to the creation of Grape Crepe, Crystal Rose had the opportunity to work with MegaRaw’s brand-building, in-house selected phenotype of Pie Dough, and he crossed it with his own Pie Eyed selection to create Pie Dough Bx1. He then crossed Pie Dough Bx1 with Grape Pie Wedding Crasher, a male known for its abundant resin and grape terps, to create Grape Crepe. Our cultivation team has selected two phenotypes of Grape Crepe: one for flower and the other for solventless extracts, and we have found this cultivar to be a wild improvement on the grape category as a whole. Opening a jar of our flower phenotype, Grape Crepe #61, launches a purple wave of grape juice and grape candy streaked with a subtle gassy note – an aroma that translates impeccably to flavor with vaporization or combustion. A balanced combination of stress-melting relaxation and uplifting euphoria is consistent with its lineage of Pie Dough, Grape Pie, Wedding Cake, and Purple Punch.

202.desc:
Mintlato is a hybrid born of Animal Mints and Gelato 41, showcasing a terpene cast led by limonene, caryophyllene, humulene, myrcene, and pinene. At first draw, limonene brings a bright citrus zing that awakens the senses, while pinene’s fresh pine notes add a brisk clarity. Myrcene’s earthy, musky undertones lend a plush, soothing backdrop, and caryophyllene’s spicy warmth weaves through the mix, rounding out the flavor with a subtle peppery edge. Humulene’s herbal whisper ties everything together, creating a complex, mint-tinged profile that feels both crisp and luxuriant.

Onset is marked by a light uplift—limonene promotes a buoyant sense of optimism, lifting the spirit without racing the mind. As that initial glow settles, myrcene and humulene ease the body into gentle relaxation, melting away tension without heavy sedation. Pinene’s clarity helps maintain focus, keeping thoughts crisp even as a comfortable calm washes over you. The result is a balanced high that can fuel creative bursts, spark conversation, or simply enhance a lazy afternoon with a refreshing twist.

With its harmonious interplay of invigorating and soothing notes, Mintlato invites you to explore a variety of activities. Tackle a brainstorming session with newfound clarity, lose yourself in mellow music with a relaxed frame of mind, or savor a quiet moment of reflection as the minty breeze lingers on your palate - Mintlato adapts to your mood, amplifying joy and composure in equal measure.

The flavor follows through with a smooth combination of sweet banana, creamy dessert notes, and a lightly fruity, soft earthy finish on the exhale.

209.desc:
This drop is bigger than just flower. It’s about legacy, culture, and respect.

White Boy Kev is a Washington Heights legend. Back in the early 90’s, when the city was in the grip of the crack epidemic, Kev chose a different lane. He carved out his own path with weed because he never saw it as a drug – to him it was medicine, community, and love for the block. It was a way to uplift, not harm. Running three spots in the Heights, Kev built his name the real way: he gave the community something authentic, something that healed.

Fast-forward 35 years, and Kev's still in it for the plant – not just as a hustler, but as a grower. His pursuit now is mastery: learning, evolving, and working with cultivators who share his dedication to quality. That's why teaming up with niche. made sense – Jersey and Washington Heights are just a river apart, and this collaboration bridges that gap.

Irish Springz celebrates a genuine legend in the game. This is legacy work – paying homage to the ones who paved the way while pushing the culture forward.

----

Irish Springz is a hybrid that delivers a clean, nostalgic flavor experience—sweet notes that flow into delicate floral characteristics before finishing with that distinctive soapy dryer sheet aroma that gives this strain its name.

Effects might offer that balanced flow between mental clarity and physical relaxation. Many people appreciate how this one can work for different parts of the day, though everyone's experience varies. With 34.53% Total THC and a terpene profile led by ß-Caryophyllene and d-Limonene, this strain brings both potency and complexity to the table.

This hybrid connects with those who want flavors that tell a story and effects that keep things real. It's got that old-school authenticity with modern craft appeal—a strain that represents legacy, culture, and the bridge between street wisdom and cultivation mastery for those looking to experience something with genuine roots.

The strain was first introduced to the market amid a wave of interest in purple-colored weed strains, which had gained traction as a symbol of both beauty and high potency. The dominant scent profile carries unmistakable hints of sweet grapes with subtle undertones of earthy musk and berry.

At the onset, the strain is known to induce euphoria, characterized by heightened mental clarity and an elevated mood. This phase is typically marked by an immediate burst of creative energy, making it suitable for social settings and creative endeavors.

As the high deepens, users begin to experience profound physical relaxation, which is reflective of the strain’s indica heritage. Medical users have noted that this shift can be particularly beneficial for relieving muscle tension, chronic pain, and stress-related symptoms.

234.desc: The Strain: Max AC stands as a pinnacle of hybrid ingenuity, brought to life by Greenpoint Genetics through an inspired cross of MAC 1 and Animal Cookies. This strain captures the essence of two powerhouse genetics, blending the resin-rich, robust character of MAC 1 with the flavor-forward, distinctive profile of Animal Cookies. The result is a hybrid that delivers a compelling fusion of clear headed euphoria and soothing physical calm, tailored for those seeking both mental spark and grounded relaxation. The flavor profile of Max AC is a journey in complexity and depth. It opens with a bright citrus burst provided by limonene, delivering an immediate zing that awakens the senses. The spicy, peppery nuances of caryophyllene interlace with the rich, earthy foundation of myrcene and humulene, creating a multi-layered taste that is both robust and satisfying. Bisabolol rounds out the experience with subtle floral hints, adding an elegant softness that completes the symphony of flavors. The result is an immersive, gourmet experience that dances between tangy citrus, spicy earthiness, and delicate floral sweetness. As the high unfolds, Max AC sets the stage for a state of inspired focus and tranquil contentment. The initial rush sparks an elevated mood, fueling creative thoughts and a sense of invigorated drive ideal for sketching out new ideas or engaging in reflective planning. Gradually, a soothing calm pervades the body, nurturing a feeling of quiet satisfaction and mental clarity. Brute's Roots "Blue Lobzter" 3.5g is a premium, indica-dominant hybrid cannabis flower cultivated and distributed across recreational dispensaries in New Jersey. This award-winning strain is a rare cross between Apples N Bananas and Eye Candy, originally popularized by Maine Trees and bred by Chris Lynch.

Strain Profile & Characteristics

• Lineage: Apples N Bananas x Eye Candy
• Type: Indica-Dominant Hybrid
• Potency & Terpenes: Batches from Brute's Roots typically test quite high, showing around 32.9% THC and 2.14% Terpenes.
• Appearance: Dense, resinous emerald buds featuring deep blue and purple undertones, heavily frosted in trichomes and accented by fiery orange hairs—resembling a unique "lobster shell" aesthetic.
• Aroma & Flavor: A complex "fruity gas" profile. It leads with a sweet, sugary blueberry candy and grape flavor, followed by hints of tart green apples, creamy undertones, and a smooth citrus/gassy finish.

Effects & Experience

Chef brings an upbeat, euphoric experience with a social-friendly vibe, making it a great choice for sharing with friends, creative moments, or simply enjoying a flavorful hybrid session.

It delivers a versatile experience that begins with a bright, creative cerebral uplift before transitioning into a deeply relaxing body high that avoids heavy couch-lock. For cultivators, the strain is highly prized for its vibrant purple and autumn coloration, massive yields, and exceptional suitability for hash production.

This composition delivers a unique sensory contrast, blending the sweet, chalky flavor of pink hard candies and berries with a pungent, gassy diesel undertone. Users generally experience an initial upbeat, creative head buzz that smoothly transitions into a deeply relaxing, euphoric body high.

261.desc: Grown Rogue Lantz (3.5g) delivers a complex aromatic profile defined by a sharp contrast of sweet tart candy and rich citrus layered over a heavy, pungent diesel and pine gas undertone. Over time, this energetic onset smoothly transitions into a deeply grounding physical relaxation that relieves muscle tension without causing overwhelming sedation. Because of this balanced, dual-stage effect, consumers frequently look to this strain for late-afternoon or evening use to help manage stress, anxiety, and insomnia.

Despite its high potency, it smoothly balances this cerebral stimulation with stress-relieving body relaxation that avoids heavy couch-lock, offering a premium yet value-forward smoking experience.

The experience begins with a gentle cerebral calm that eases racing thoughts before transitioning into a heavy, soothing body relaxation. As the effects build, users often report a tranquil, sedating finish that makes Star Killer ideal for quiet nights, movie marathons, or preparing for restful sleep.

Dr. Funkenstein, also known as "Dr. Funk," is an indica-dominant hybrid strain cultivated by Royal King Seeds. Dr. Funkenstein offers a flavorful journey that delights the palate with a blend of sweet berry notes and earthy sharpness, reflecting its rich genetic heritage.

The strain's primary terpene profile includes Myrcene, Pinene, and Caryophyllene, contributing to its distinctive flavors and effects. Myrcene enhances the sweet, fruity aroma and promotes a sense of relaxation. Pinene introduces subtle pine undertones that can uplift and refresh the senses, while Caryophyllene adds a spicy hint that elevates the overall taste experience. This harmonious combination results in a flavor profile featuring berry, blueberry, cheesy, and sweet notes that make each encounter with Dr. Funkenstein uniquely enjoyable.

Dr. Funkenstein is celebrated for inducing a multifaceted experience that pleasantly envelops both mind and body. Users often report an onset of euphoria and cerebral stimulation, fostering feelings of happiness and creativity. As the journey continues, it gradually transitions into a powerful body sensation that promotes deep relaxation and a laid-back state. This progression may lead to increased appetite and a gentle inclination toward introspection, accompanied by a soothing, sleepy feeling. Drawing from its Blueberry and Bubba Kush lineage, Dr. Funkenstein offers a well-rounded experience that balances uplifting mental effects with calming physical relaxation.

The Gorilla Pie strain has an aroma containing earthy notes with tea and grapefruit. Gorilla Pie’s dominant terpene is pinene, ensuring a fresh smell that delights the senses.

This cannabis strain has a sweet flavor with berries, spicy herbs, and peppery diesel undertones. For people with chronic pain, the Gorilla Pie strain is favored for its medicinal benefits—such as pain relief and anxiety reduction. The Black Maple strain is a unique hybrid strain that combines the genetic traits of the Dulce De Uva and Sherbanger strains. Sherbanger, the other parent of Black Maple, is known for its rich, creamy flavor and dense, frosty buds. By combining the two, Bloom Seeds has created a stellar hybrid that embodies all the qualities of an elite strain.

The flavor of this strain is just as delightful, coating the mouth with the sweet flavors of blueberry ice cream and exotic spices. The taste lingers for several minutes, making for a pleasant experience that any cannabis user is sure to love.

288.desc:
Mintlato is a hybrid born of Animal Mints and Gelato 41, showcasing a terpene cast led by limonene, caryophyllene, humulene, myrcene, and pinene. At first draw, limonene brings a bright citrus zing that awakens the senses, while pinene’s fresh pine notes add a brisk clarity. Myrcene’s earthy, musky undertones lend a plush, soothing backdrop, and caryophyllene’s spicy warmth weaves through the mix, rounding out the flavor with a subtle peppery edge. Humulene’s herbal whisper ties everything together, creating a complex, mint-tinged profile that feels both crisp and luxuriant.

Onset is marked by a light uplift—limonene promotes a buoyant sense of optimism, lifting the spirit without racing the mind. As that initial glow settles, myrcene and humulene ease the body into gentle relaxation, melting away tension without heavy sedation. Pinene’s clarity helps maintain focus, keeping thoughts crisp even as a comfortable calm washes over you. The result is a balanced high that can fuel creative bursts, spark conversation, or simply enhance a lazy afternoon with a refreshing twist.

With its harmonious interplay of invigorating and soothing notes, Mintlato invites you to explore a variety of activities. Tackle a brainstorming session with newfound clarity, lose yourself in mellow music with a relaxed frame of mind, or savor a quiet moment of reflection as the minty breeze lingers on your palate - Mintlato adapts to your mood, amplifying joy and composure in equal measure.

374.desc:
The Strain - Ghost OG, a cut of OG Kush, is a hybrid strain loved for its balanced cerebral and body effects. Often described as simultaneously potent and non-intrusive, Ghost OG has won itself Cup awards and renown among consumers.

Despite its intimidating name, Ghost OG is actually a mellow, relaxing strain that’s great for recreational use. This is the strain to go to when you’re having a Netflix-and-Chill day at home. As an indica-dominant hybrid, Ghost OG can melt all your worries, stressors, and anxieties away and replace them with a soothing, peaceful experience. There’s nothing better than watching your favorite comedy or listening to your favorite album than with Ghost OG in the mix.

Even though the high of Ghost OG is noticeable, it’s rarely considered to be too overpowering or overwhelming. This hybrid comes with moderate THC levels that are suitable for all smoking levels. The overall experience of Ghost OG is zen, euphoric, and giggly. This hybrid produces a happy high that veers on the cerebral side in the early stages.

The second wave of Ghost OG shows its indica side. The brain and body enter a state of pure relaxation. This can help combat feelings of pain, anxiety, nausea, and inflammation. Blueprint P90 (3.5g) is a premium, indica-dominant cannabis flower heavily nicknamed the "Gas Man" due to its remarkably pungent, room-filling aroma. It is highly regarded for its top-tier indoor cultivation quality, resinous and sticky buds, and deeply sedative, heavy-hitting effects.

Strain Overview & Lineage

Lineage: P90 is a powerhouse cross between Gorilla Glue #4 (GG4) x Gelato 41, bringing together elite genetics that offer deep chemical, earthy, and sweet dessert qualities.

Appearance: Dense, hard, medium-sized light green buds layered with vibrant hues of violet and blue, completely coated in a heavy white layer of shimmering, resinous trichomes.

Aroma, Flavor, and Terpene Profile

The strain is famous for a "nose-burning funk" that combines traditional gassy undertones with unique flavor complexities:

Scent: A powerful infusion of skunk, diesel fuel, hazelnut, and chemicals, with a subtle menthol finish.

Taste: A clean, heavy inhale of gassy, creamy earthiness balanced by faint, sweet floral undertones on the exhale.

Dominant Terpenes: Testing reveals a profile heavily dominated by Beta-Caryophyllene, followed by Limonene, Linalool, and Humulene .

Experience & Effects

The High: Expect an immediate full-body melt that dissolves physical tension, creates "heavy eyes," and brings on a deeply tranquil state of mind.

Best Used For: Unwinding after a long day, managing physical aches, easing severe insomnia, or any evening routine dedicated to deep relaxation.

484.desc:
Triple Lindy is a award-winning premium hybrid cannabis strain bred by Blueprint Cannabis Co. that achieved major acclaim by winning Best Overall and Most Potent at the 2022 Winter Zalympix competition. Named after the famous impossible dive from the movie Back to School, this cultivar is highly regarded in the dessert-gas category for its heavy-hitting potency and dense, frosty bag appeal.

Genetic Lineage & Profile

While some early industry sources listed its family tree as a mystery, it is widely recognized as a modern hybrid cross between Z (Zkittlez) and Gelato 41 (G41).

Type: Indica-dominant leaning hybridStructure: Dense calyx stacking, tight internodal spacing, and a heavy coating of trichomes making it visually striking.

Cultivation: Notoriously difficult and sensitive to grow, but highly rewarding for experienced cultivators.

Flavor and Aroma Profile

The strain features a complex, layered "dessert-gas" profile that combines sweet and deeply savory elements:

Aroma: A pungent mix of rubber, musk, tropical fruit, and sweet candy gas.

Flavor: Creamy, doughy sweetness upfront, blending into heavy diesel, cheese, and a peppery-citrus finish.

Dominant Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Linalool, Humulene, and Pinene.

Experienced Effects

Triple Lindy delivers a potent "one-two-three punch" that satisfies both physical and cerebral preferences:

Cerebral Lift: An immediate euphoric rush that boosts mood and relieves mental stress.

Body High: A deeply relaxing, heavy physical sedation that spreads across the limbs without immediate couchlock, making it ideal for evening use

494.desc:
Harvest Moon Farms Purple Elephant (3.5g) is an Indica flower strain known for its deeply relaxing effects and distinct fruit-forward profile. It is widely available across dispensaries in New Jersey.

The true pedigree of Purple Elephant carries a bit of West Coast mystery, but cannabis historians and breeders generally agree on its roots:

The Mother: Purple Urkle, a legendary cultivar originating from the Pacific Northwest (Mendocino/Humboldt County). This passes down the intense grape candy aromatics and heavy, relaxing traits.

The Father: The original cut is believed to be a cross between Purple Urkle and an undisclosed variety—frequently attributed as either a robust Gage Green selection or a mystery Sativa line that added structural heft and larger colas.

Aroma & Flavor
Nose: Breaking open a jar releases a pungent burst of sweet grape candy and musty, damp earth. It is backed by sharp dark berry edges and a woodsy, herbal spice.

Taste: The smoke is smooth and layered. It leads with a heavy sweetness reminiscent of ripe berries and artificial grape candy, finishing with a sharp, kushy earthiness and subtle chemical undertones on the exhale.

Effects & Therapeutic Uses:
While standard cuts of Purple Elephant can occasionally lean into daytime focus, the specific Harvest Moon Farms batch leans into a heavier evening profile:

The High: It hits quickly, initiating a calming euphoria that blankety wraps both mind and body. Users report feeling deeply serene, relaxed, and mildly hungry without immediate couch-lock, though high doses transition quickly into deep sleepiness.

Medical Benefits: According to Leafwell, the strain “is often used for its potential to relieve stress, anxiety, and depression. It may also help with pain management and insomnia due to its relaxing and sedating effects.

Each jar contains smaller buds with a higher piece count, while still preserving lush aromas and rich flavors true to each strain. Carefully cultivated and quality tested, RYTHM Mini Buds are ideal for everyday enjoyment, offering excellent performance, consistent effects, and exceptional value.

Purple Starfruit [orig: Platinum GSC x LilMissHS] is an indica that delivers deep berry on the inhale, easing into creamy sweetness, gentle earth, and floral funk.

496.desc: GLASS MEADOWS presents Papaya Crush, a premium indica whole flower packaged in a convenient 3.5g format. This hand-selected strain delivers the deeply relaxing effects indica lovers seek, wrapped in a tropical flavor experience. Expect sweet, fruity notes reminiscent of ripe papaya with subtle earthy undertones that create a smooth, satisfying smoke. Papaya Crush is ideal for evening unwinding, helping you melt away stress and tension while promoting full-body relaxation. Whether you're seeking relief after a long day or preparing for restful sleep, this flower offers consistent quality and potency. The whole flower pre-pack ensures freshness and convenience, perfect for those who appreciate craft cannabis without the hassle. Experience the soothing embrace of Papaya Crush and discover why GLASS MEADOWS is trusted for exceptional indica strains.

497.desc: Pez is an indica-leaning cannabis cultivar celebrated for its candy-like sweetness, compact structure, and calming, mood-brightening effects. The name nods to the nostalgic candy, and the sensory profile often delivers berry, vanilla, and powdered-sugar notes that make the comparison feel apt. In dispensary menus, you will also encounter Pink Pez, a closely related phenotype or line selection prized for a slightly more floral bouquet and a pastel blush that can appear in its pistils and bracts.

498.desc:
Lineage: Oreoz x Zero Gravity 

Deep Space delivers a euphoric, spaced-out high that’s both relaxing and mood-lifting. Its sharp aroma combines metallic fuel and industrial cleaner notes, while the flavor is hash-forward with a sweet finish. Expect a mix of chemical, diesel, and sugary tones, paired with a high that’s perfect for unwinding and laughing your way through the cosmos.

499.desc: EXOTICA GARDENS presents GG4, a legendary indica flower in a convenient 3.5g pre-pack format. Also known as Gorilla Glue 4, this powerhouse strain delivers deeply relaxing effects that melt away stress and tension. GG4 is celebrated for its pungent, earthy aroma with notes of pine and diesel fuel, creating a distinctive profile that's instantly recognizable. The flavor follows through with rich, woody undertones accented by hints of coffee and chocolate. Perfect for evening use, this indica promotes full-body relaxation, making it ideal for unwinding after a long day or easing into restful sleep. Users often report feeling euphoric, happy, and deeply calm. Whether you're seeking relief or simply want to relax, this 3.5g jar of GG4 flower delivers consistent quality and potent effects that have made it a cannabis community favorite.

500.desc:
Feelz | Hooch | Flower | 14g

Hooch is an indica-dominant weed strain bred by Purple City Genetics from a genetic cross of Slurty3 x Street Guru. This is a strain heavy on the bag appeal, with gaudy, sage-colored buds flecked with purple and ample trichomes. Hooch blends the sweet, berry, minty, diesel, and herbal aromas and flavors of its many parent strains. Consumers and medical patients can expect relaxing and euphoric effects.

501.desc:
Strain Overview: Dulce de Papaya
• Lineage: An indica-leaning hybrid cross of Dulce de Uva × Papaya (originally bred by Bloom Seed Co).
• Aroma & Flavor: Features a tropical fusion of ripe papaya, sweet grape candy, and creamy citrus, backed by subtle tropical funk and earthy spice.
• Effects: Provides an initial uplifting wave of euphoria and mental clarity that transitions into a soothing, full-body relaxation

502.desc: Harvest Moon Farms Sticky Bobbi 7g is a premium, Indica-dominant hybrid cannabis flower (a cross of Sunshine x Purple Flamingo). Known for its sweet, skunky aroma with citrus and earthy undertones, this strain delivers a balanced experience that starts with a bright, euphoric, and creative lift before settling into a deeply relaxing body high. The 7g quarter-ounce package offers high-quality full buds ideal for users seeking both functional creativity and physical relaxation.

503.desc: Full Tilt Labs' Beef Supreme (3.5g) is a high-potency, Indica-dominant hybrid strain that delivers a robust, savory profile of earthy undertones, sharp black pepper, and diesel fuel. Driven by dominant terpenes like Limonene and Beta-Caryophyllene, it provides a fast-acting, dual-action experience: an initial wave of uplifting cerebral euphoria and mental clarity that smoothly transitions into a heavy, deeply relaxing body high and sedative finish.

504.desc:
• The Genotype Profile: "Special Z" is selected to capture the bright, sweet, candy-heavy attributes of original Zkittlez, often crossed with a secret or proprietary balancing strain to optimize trichome density and structural growth.

• Aroma Profile: It leans much heavier into a sweet, artificial fruity candy and tropical citrus profile, scaling back slightly on the heavy, skunky diesel "funk" that dominates their other Z-hybrids.

• Effects: Consumers generally find it to be a slightly more balanced or uplifting Hybrid/Indica-Hybrid experience compared to their pure sedative offerings, providing functional physical relaxation with a more prominent cerebral, euphoric buzz.

505.desc: First Round Pick by Hugh Douglas is a hard-hitting, premium Indica-Hybrid cannabis strain. It delivers a sharp, pungent aroma dominated by bright lemon and citrus notes, rounded out by a sweet, earthy, and herbal depth driven by its top terpenes, Limonene, Myrcene, and Linalool. Because of its high potency and negligible CBD, this strain provides a deeply calming, physical body high and heavy relaxation, making it an ideal choice for evening use, stress relief, and winding down.

506.desc: Grand Daddy Pluto is a potent, indica-dominant hybrid that delivers a rich, dessert-forward aroma defined by sweet blueberry jam and dark berries, accented by an earthy, gas-like musk and a cool, minty exhale. The experience begins with an immediate cerebral rush of euphoria and mental clarity that elevates the mood and eases stress, before gradually shifting into a heavy, full-body sedation. This deep, couch-locking physical relaxation makes the strain highly effective for melting away muscle tension, managing pain, and combating insomnia during evening or nighttime use.

507.desc: A cross between JMO and Slurup created Candied Garlic a strain that captivates with its irresistible combination of super chewy calyx structures. The initial notes of garlic and gas create an intense flavor explosion while the delightful hints of berries and cake on the back end add a surprising sweetness.

508.desc:
Bring bold flavor and standout genetics to your flower rotation with Facetz by Delight. This balanced 50/50 hybrid comes from Pavé x Gastro Pop #5, bred by Compound Genetics, and catches the eye with prismatic green buds and frosty, milky calyxes. Its complex flavor profile blends pungent diesel and savory cheese with juicy berry notes, while select expressions may lean toward fruity sweetness or minty fuel.

Facetz is associated with a happy, uplifted, creative vibe balanced by a calming edge, making it a versatile option for a variety of sessions.

509.desc:
Garlic Ice Cream packs a weirdly sweet yet savory, vanilla ice cream flavor that's blended with rich herbal garlic and a hint of honey.

LINEAGE: GMO x Dosilato x Gelato #25

EFFECTS: Relaxing body high, uplifting cerebral effects that will leave you satisfied with every puff!

510.desc: Hash Burger provides a calming and relaxing experience. It delivers tension relief, uplifting euphoria, and induces a strong appetite. This strain soothes racing thoughts and provides mood stability. Hash Burger is a smooth smoke with hints of sweet and spicy combinations. Indica Hybrid Terpenes: Limonene, beta-Myrcene, beta-Caryophyllene, alpha-Humulene, cis-Nerolidol, beta-Pinene, Fenchol alpha-Pinene Lineage: (Han solo burger x Black Triangle) x Double Burger Aroma/Flavors: Spicy Lemon, Pine, Woody, Flowery Ailments: Insomnia, Mood Swings, PTSD, Appetite Loss Effects: Euphoria, Happiness, Uplifting, Relaxing

511.desc:
Lineage: Y8 (Ylife x 8 Mile Runtz) x Lemon Cherry Sherbert

Panther Runts by Dan Trocki Farms is a premium cannabis flower featuring a sweet, candy-inspired flavor profile with hints of tropical fruit, creamy undertones, and subtle earthy gas. Drawing inspiration from the classic Runtz family of strains, Panther Runts offers an aromatic experience that combines fruity sweetness with a rich, pungent finish.

512.desc:
My Dad’s Stash’s Heir Heads is a flavorful flower offering a classic, balanced profile with a modern polish in a convenient 3.5g format. Built from Heirloom Hybrid lineage, it delivers an approachable character for enthusiasts who appreciate smooth, dependable flower.

Expect earthy spice layered with subtle sweetness for a refined aroma and flavorful smoke. The profile is balanced and easygoing, blending classic cannabis character with a clean, polished finish.

Heir Heads offers a smooth, reliable experience that makes it an easy addition to any flower rotation, whether you’re enjoying a solo session or sharing with friends.

513.desc: "Zoltar" by My Dad's Stash is a potent, indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain available in 3.5-gram flower jars. Crossing OGKB 2.1 with Jar Jar Stinks, this premium flower delivers a heavy complex, pungent aroma of diesel, savory garlic, sweet cookie dough, and warm spices. Users report that the experience begins with a happy, euphoric head rush before deeply settling into a heavy physical relaxation, making it an ideal choice for a sedative evening unwind or a total "brain turn-off" at the end of the day.

514.desc: The Lid offers premium pre-ground flower with no stems or leaf ready to roll or bake. The Lid is available in half ounces & full ounces and they come with a pack of King size rolling papers. Instead of classifying these as strain specific, terpenes are meticulously paired to provide that perfect combination! Trust us, not only will your taste buds thank you, but you’re body will be comforted by the perfect night’s sleep that will ensure after trying this strain.

At first its playful and uplifting, often sparking creativity and a euphoric boost that makes everything hit harder. The buds themselves mirror the name: fluffy and trichome covered with punchy bright tones that pop visually under the light.

517.desc: Mini Buds offer a variety of expertly cultivated and meticulously cured strains with optimal potencies, lush aromas, and rich flavors. 520.desc:
**Diamond Infused Show Dogs**

Couch Crasher is a heavy-hitting indica that leans into its name with dense, sticky buds and a deep, earthy aroma layered with sweet funk and a touch of spice. This strain delivers rich flavor and strong presence, making it a solid choice for those who prefer their flower with weight and character. Expect smooth smoke, bold terpene expression, and that unmistakable “sink-into-the-cushions” kind of vibe. When it’s time to slow down, Couch Crasher doesn’t just suggest it—it insists.

 Indica-dominant hybrid

523.desc:
The Haze x Mudd Brothers Mandarin Diesel x Zero Gravity Live Rosin Infused Pre-Roll (1g) is a premium, award-winning Indica-dominant cannabis pre-roll. 524.desc:
**Diamond Infused**

525.desc:
This one is Z Hive, out of our Hash Joint line. It comes as an infused pre-roll. It tested at 35.1% THC on August 28, 2026, where infused flower usually sits.

A single joint: 80% flower, 20% pure ice water hash. Smooth, potent, and full of flavor.

526.desc:
Honey Banana is an Indica-dominant hybrid known for its decadent dessert-like flavor and a balanced high that melts away physical tension without causing immediate couch-lock. 

Because the Pre-Roll King of Jersey "Dirty Jerseys" pack is infused with THCA diamonds, the initial onset of this specific profile will hit much faster and feel significantly more potent than standard flower.

527.desc:
Step into the warmth of a Sunday morning kitchen with every draw of Blueberry Muffin infused prerolls. These prerolls merge plump, fragrant berries with rich infused oil, capturing the juicy sweetness of freshly baked muffins in a convenient, hand-rolled format. As smoke drifts across your palate, ripe blueberry notes burst forth, their tang balanced by soft vanilla undertones and a whisper of buttery crust. This fusion of fruit and pastry creates an indulgent flavor that feels both familiar and delightfully novel. 

The aroma of Blueberry Muffin prerolls is a comforting embrace of sweet dough and berry compote. Limonene’s bright citrus lift enlivens the blend, cutting through the richness with a zesty edge, while myrcene’s earthy musk adds depth and smooths each puff. Caryophyllene contributes a gentle peppery warmth, giving the overall profile a subtle spice that lingers on the tongue. Linalool’s floral hints round out the experience, adding a delicate softness that soothes the senses and rounds off the flavor journey. 

When you unwind with Blueberry Muffin, a gentle calm settles in, easing tension and inviting a contented smile. Thoughts drift to fond memories as a relaxed clarity takes over, letting ideas flow without rush. A lingering lightness accompanies the mellow euphoria, making these prerolls an excellent choice for reflective afternoons or chill nights.

528.desc: Local Skunk Infused is a 2.5G pre-roll from cheetah. Expect classic green funk, herbal bite, and a little old-school snap. THC-led with CBG present; beta-caryophyllene, humulene, beta-myrcene, linalool lead the terpene panel.

529.desc: The PAR Hash Infused Irons (Pine Valley Reserve) is a high-potency, hash-infused 5-pack of pre-rolled joints featuring a woodsy aroma of fresh pine, earthy musk, and citrusy diesel. The product delivers a long-lasting, deeply relaxing body buzz alongside euphoric mental clarity that eventually settles into a sedating calm.

530.desc: Garden Greens brings you PayDaze, a premium diamond-infused preroll that takes your relaxation to the next level. This 2.5g Indica preroll pack is expertly crafted with potent THCA diamonds infused throughout, delivering enhanced effects and an unforgettable experience. PayDaze offers the deeply calming, full-body relaxation that Indica lovers crave, making it ideal for unwinding after a long day or settling in for a restful evening. Expect soothing, tranquil effects that melt away tension and stress while promoting a peaceful state of mind. The diamond infusion amplifies potency, providing a powerful and long-lasting experience that's perfect for seasoned consumers seeking something extraordinary.

531.desc:
The Strain - Named for its super hazy, heady high and gorgeous appearance, Violet Fog is the perfect choice for any connoisseur of classic indicas. Violet Fog has a sweet and fruity grape flavor with a spicy and skunky exhale. The aroma takes a pungent turn, with a heavy rotting grapes overtone accented by a punch of skunkiness. The buds of Violet Fog have gorgeous, fluffy, grape-shaped, dark olive green nugs with bright purple undertones, thin orange hairs and a coating of bright purple-white crystal trichomes.

The high produced from Violet Fog is one that's perfect for a lazy evening or afternoon, with hazy and unfocused effects that are perfect for helping you settle down after a long and stressful day. You'll feel the effects begin to settle, rolling in like the evening fog before dropping you into complete physical and mental sedation. You'll find your mind lifted with a sense of unfocused happiness that quickly turns heady and giggly.

532.desc: Dogwalkers “SIT” Mini Dog pre-rolls offer a total of 1.75g indica-leaning flower. Conveniently packaged in an on-the-go tin, each .35g miniature pre-roll (five total) is always crafted with strain-specific premium flower; never shake, stems or seeds. Dogwalkers donates a portion of proceeds from every product sold to deserving animal shelters across the country.

533.desc:
The GMO Cookies strain, commonly called Garlic Cookies, is an Indica dominant hybrid strain (90% Indica/10% Sativa) created with GSC and Chemdawg. Due to its intense aroma, euphoric high—many Indica fans are loyal to the GMO Cookies strain. Its delicious flavors of Garlic, Mushroom, and Onion are so memorable, it's where the moniker of ‘GMO’ is derived.

Better still, GMO Cookies delivers everything you’ll want from a classic Indica hybrid—including complete mind and body relaxation, enhanced mental focus, and uplifted emotions. 

Likewise, the strain is known for battling various health conditions, such as depression, chronic pain, insomnia, stress, fatigue, and body inflammation.

534.desc:
Hibernate is a potent indica strain meticulously crafted by the master breeders at Greenpoint Seeds, born from the cross of Shut Eye and Stardawg. This unique blend brings together an impressive lineage that includes Fire OG, Bubba Kush, Alien Technology, Purple Kush, and Chemdog. Hibernate lives up to its name by offering deeply relaxing and soothing effects, making it an ideal choice for those seeking tranquility and restful sleep. Its terpene profile features Nerolidol 2, Limonene, Humulene, Myrcene, and Bisabolol, all contributing to its distinctive flavor and calming properties.

The flavor profile of Hibernate leans toward earthy and woody notes, complemented by hints of pine and a strong lemon peel accent. Limonene adds a citrusy zest that brightens the overall taste, while Myrcene and Humulene contribute to the strain's herbal and earthy undertones. Bisabolol introduces subtle floral nuances, enhancing the complexity of the flavor. The aroma is equally captivating, with variations that include lemon tones, cherry, rock candy, and the skunky essence characteristic of Stardawg.

Drawing from its rich genetic background, Hibernate offers a profoundly relaxing and euphoric experience. Users often report feelings of deep calmness and serenity, with a gentle wave of sleepiness that envelops both mind and body. The influence of Shut Eye provides intensely soothing effects, while Stardawg adds a touch of uplifting euphoria. This harmonious blend makes Hibernate an excellent choice for unwinding after a long day, promoting a peaceful state of mind and preparing for a restful night's sleep.

535.desc:
The Strain - Named for its super hazy, heady high and gorgeous appearance, Violet Fog is the perfect choice for any connoisseur of classic indicas. Violet Fog has a sweet and fruity grape flavor with a spicy and skunky exhale. The aroma takes a pungent turn, with a heavy rotting grapes overtone accented by a punch of skunkiness. The buds of Violet Fog have gorgeous, fluffy, grape-shaped, dark olive green nugs with bright purple undertones, thin orange hairs and a coating of bright purple-white crystal trichomes.

The high produced from Violet Fog is one that's perfect for a lazy evening or afternoon, with hazy and unfocused effects that are perfect for helping you settle down after a long and stressful day. You'll feel the effects begin to settle, rolling in like the evening fog before dropping you into complete physical and mental sedation. You'll find your mind lifted with a sense of unfocused happiness that quickly turns heady and giggly.

537.desc: "Rythm swamp water fumes" refers to the Swamp Water Fumez cannabis strain, a hybrid produced by the cannabis brand RYTHM. This strain is known for its balanced indica-leaning effects, a unique sensory experience combining sweet, musky dankness with floral, spicy, and citrusy notes.

538.desc: Orangutang is a flavorful indica-dominant hybrid.. It was created by crossing two heavily citrus-forward strains, Orange Crush and Citrus Sap, with two flavorful and potent cannabis mainstays, GG4 and Tangie. The flowers sprout light green buds that smell of oranges, grapefruit, earth, and gasoline. Its sour undertones give way to rapid physical relaxation and a euphoric headband sensation. Orangutang is a great option for people looking to boost their mood while attending to pain.

539.desc: Frost Donkey is a remarkable indica strain, Its effects induce a relaxed, euphoric, and happy feeling, promoting a sense of calmness and well-being. The strain's flavor profile is characterized by earthy undertones, with hints of lemon and citrus, creating a refreshing and enjoyable sensory experience.

540.desc:
The Bruce Banner weed strain, often called Banner or OG Banner, is a hybrid cannabis strain with creative, relaxing, and euphoric side effects.

You can expect speedy effects from the Bruce Banner strain because of the high THC levels, before settling into a head high with potential full-body relaxation.

The original cultivators—Dark Horse Genetics—bred the strain with OG Kush x Strawberry Diesel. Likewise, they named the cannabis strain after Bruce Banner, the fictional Hulk character from Marvel Universe.

Users often report a diesel aroma with sweet undertones, and the strain’s dominant terpene is myrcene.

541.desc: This celebrity child boasts a super delicious flavor and full-bodied effects that will have you fully kicked back for hours on end. Like its parent strains, Apple Cheesecake has a taste of sweet creamy cheesecake with a sour apple overtone. The aroma takes a heavier turn, bringing dank chemicals and pungent sour fruits to the table, too. The Apple Cheesecake hits you almost as soon as you exhale, rocking your mind before slowly taking control of your body, too. You'll feel an immediate sense of lifted happiness that's slightly unfocused and pretty heady in nature. As your mind lifts higher and higher, a deep sense of calm will work its way throughout your body, locking you to the couch and leaving you pretty hungry at times.

542.desc: Unicorn Poop is an evenly balanced hybrid strain (50% indica/50% sativa) created through crossing the delicious GMO X Sophisticated Lady strains. Don't let the name of this bud scare you off – Unicorn Poop actually packs a super delicious flavor! This bud has a taste of sweet yet sour citrusy fruits with hints of freshly ripened berries and a touch of earthiness. The aroma is very similar, with a fruity berry overtone accented by spicy diesel, sour citrus and fresh earthy herbs. The Unicorn Poop high is just as delightful, with a euphoric overtone that will leave both mind and body flying high for hours on end. You'll feel your mood almost instantly boosted as you're infused with a sense of pure happiness and ease that's filled with giggly laughter and sociability. A soothing body high accompanies this heady state, helping you to relax with an almost weightless sense that won't tie you down to the couch.

543.desc:
Zuava offers a vibrant terpene profile with sweet tropical fruit, juicy berry, and creamy candy notes layered with subtle earthy depth. The aroma is bright and fruit-forward, creating a smooth, flavorful smoke with a rich finish.

This indica provides a balanced experience with uplifting euphoria and comfortable relaxation, making it a versatile choice for daytime enjoyment, social sessions, or a laid-back evening.

544.desc:
Billionaire is an opulent indica-dominant hybrid cannabis cultivar that has gained recognition in the ultra-premium market. It is commonly described as a cross between Wedding Cake and a potent OG Kush phenotype (Billionaire OG), engineered for high resin output and strong physical effects.

Known for its dense trichome coverage and refined “cake-gas” terpene profile, Billionaire is widely selected by connoisseurs who prioritize potency, flavor complexity, and extract quality. Its appeal centers on deep relaxation, heavy body effects, and a smooth, high-end sensory experience.

545.desc:
Cadillac Rainbows offers a robust smoke with strong diesel, lemon, and cherry flavors and subtle hints of mint. This strain offers pain relief and mental clarity. Cadillac Rainbows can also be used to treat a lack of appetite. This strain is preferred in the cannabis community due to its numerous medicinal effects.

549.desc: The PAR Putter Pack in Pine Valley Reserve is a golf-themed cannabis four-pack of 0.5-gram mini pre-rolls. The strain features an earthy, musky, and pine-forward aroma dominated by Beta-Myrcene, delivering deeply sedating and relaxing physical effects ideal for unwinding.

Happy Farmer Candied Garlic is a 1G pre-roll pack (two 0.5g joints) of indoor-grown hybrid flower. It starts with savory notes of garlic and gas, transitioning to a surprising sweetness with hints of berries and cake on the exhale.

This hybrid is a cross of JMO x Slurrup, a combination that delivers a unique savory-sweet flavor profile.

Ideal for an evening of culinary exploration or a cozy night in, where its complex flavors can be fully appreciated.

The Happy Farmer, a New Jersey cultivator, is committed to producing high-quality, sustainably-grown cannabis in small batches, with all flower hand-processed in a climate-controlled indoor facility.

552.desc: This Indica-dominant hybrid, a cross of Chimera and Grape Jubilee, offers a sweet and fruity profile dominated by vibrant grape and berry notes, balanced by subtle hints of earthiness. Kacklesnatch is celebrated for its clear-headed relaxation, making it perfect for unwinding without heavy sedation. It also helps to ease anxiety and foster a more talkative, social mood.

553.desc: Garden Greens GMO Cookies is a highly potent, Indica-dominant powerhouse famous for its unapologetically bold and savory garlic, raw onion, and chemical diesel aroma, fueled by a sharp blend of caryophyllene and volatile sulfur compounds. It delivers a fast-acting mental euphoria that quickly gives way to a profound, long-lasting full-body sedation. Because it heavily induces couch-lock, triggers intense munchies, and melts away physical pain and stress, this heavy hitter is strictly a late-night strain best saved for deep relaxation, combating insomnia, or winding down your day.

554.desc: A fabulous nighttime strain for an evening when you need a little extra oomph to get dozing, Peak 112 is the perfect tasty treat for any indica lover. The high will wash over you slowly, beginning with a tingle felt in the back of the head and forehead. This tingle will soon begin to ebb and flow throughout your entire body, relaxing it as it goes and eventually leaving you feeling totally stoned and sedated from head to toe. A mellow sense of heady happiness accompanies this physical effect, lifting your mood while still leaving you in a place of sleepy bliss.

560.desc:
Dungeon Vault Genetics’ Grapezilla stomps onto the scene as a mighty indica born from Original Glue and Vino OG. With Myrcene leading the charge, expect a mellow, musky earthiness that gently settles the mind, while Pinene’s crisp pine notes sharpen focus and clarity. Caryophyllene adds a peppery warmth that gives each inhale a spicy kick, and Limonene brings a bright citrus twist that lifts the senses. Humulene rounds out the profile with subtle herbal undertones.

Upon first puff, sweet grape flavors surge forward, underscored by a low rumble of diesel funk inherited from its Glue parentage. Myrcene’s cozy musk weaves through that grape sweetness, while Pinene’s refreshing forest breeze cuts through the richness. Caryophyllene’s peppery spice and Limonene’s lemon-lime flair mingle on the exhale, leaving a complex aftertaste that invites another toke.

Grapezilla’s effects mirror its terpene tapestry: a gradual wave of calm that encourages deep relaxation and puts the body at ease. Pinene’s clarity helps keep the mind gently engaged, so you can dive into a good book, sink into your favorite playlist, or simply relish a quiet moment. Caryophyllene’s warm embrace and Myrcene’s soothing weight make sinking into the couch all but inevitable, yet Limonene’s lift ensures you never lose complete alertness - truly the apex of chill.

We are excited to introduce THCV Rich Lemon Lime Soft Lozenges, the newest addition to our line of ratio-formulated products! The goal of our ratio-formulated line is to provide our patients with access to a line of diverse cannabinoid products that meet their specific relief and wellness needs with targeted, adjustable effects. Our THCV-Rich Soft Lozenges are unique in their formulation, because we source THCV from the in-house extraction of our own THCV-rich cultivars.

WHAT IS THCV?
Tetrahydrocannabivarin (THCV) is a lesser known cannabinoid that is starting to gain more attention for its potential appetite suppressant and energy stimulating effects. To date, THCV-forward products have not been widely available because THCV is typically found in low concentrations in many cultivars. As a result, cultivating for THCV isolate production can be costly for growers, and, consequently, the isolate may be prohibitively expensive for extract manufacturers seeking to formulate with THCV.

With this in mind, we undertook a search for cultivars that have higher concentrations of THCV. In the course of that search, we were able to find strains that, when grown at scale, allowed us to extract enough THCV for our ratio-formulated product line. 

BENEFITS
Because THCV has only recently gained attention, and because cannabis studies in general face a myriad of legal and financial obstacles, studies on THCV’s effects and symptom relief are limited. However, available research has found THCV to potentially reduce appetite, increase energy, and soothe anxiety. There is also some evidence that suggests it may curb some of THC’s intoxicating effects such as verbal recall issues, making it a potential option for patients seeking a product that allows them to be more functional during the day.

SYNERGISTIC EFFECTS:
This THCV-rich option is being offered in combination with THC because even in trace amounts, combinations of cannabinoids can produce a more effective response for patients' symptom relief. This is commonly referred to as the “Entourage Effect.”

Dissolve on Your Tongue: The fastest and most efficient delivery method. Simply place a scoop directly into your mouth and let it dissolve sublingually.

Mix Into Drinks: Because it is water-soluble, it blends smoothly without clumping. Stir a scoop into cold water, iced tea, or real lemonade to create an instant infused beverage.

Aroma: The Jack Herer strain boasts a distinctive aroma reminiscent of Pine-Sol, with lemony pine notes accented by earthy herbs and spicy flowers. Its fresh, crisp scent is instantly recognizable and adds to its appeal.

Flavor: On the palate, Jack Herer offers a sweet and sour citrusy lemon flavor with a woody pine exhale. This combination of tangy citrus and earthy pine provides a refreshing and enjoyable taste.

Effects of Jack Herer:

Jack Herer delivers an energizing and clear-headed high that can be felt almost immediately after exhaling. Its effects include:

Euphoric Lift: A clear-headed euphoria that enhances your mood, promoting a sense of motivation and mental clarity.

Creativity Boost: This strain encourages creative thinking, making it ideal for brainstorming sessions or artistic pursuits.

Focus and Sociability: Conversations come easily, and you'll feel inspired to engage in a wide range of discussions, from deep philosophical thoughts to casual chats.

861.desc: Lemon Skunk — Zesty lemon and citrus aromas with a skunky edge; generally bright, uplifting, and mood-enhancing.

862.desc:
• The Brand (LoudStash): A popular legal-market brand (highly active in states like New Jersey) known for premium flower and highly potent, terpene-rich live resin extractions.
• The Strain (Orange Durban): Also known as Orange Poison, this is a heavy sativa-dominant cross between the legendary African landrace Durban Poison and Orange Juice.
• Flavor Profile: It features a sharp, sweet citrus punch mixed with the complex, spicy, and anise-like undertones typical of Durban genetics.
• Expected Effects: Users generally turn to this profile for intense mental clarity, focus, and physical energy without heavy sedation, making it a classic daytime or creative option.

863.desc:
Ride the wave of bold flavor with Jersey Smooth’s Baja Blast, an elevated vaping experience inspired by the iconic tropical soda. This electrifying blend combines zesty lime with a touch of tropical sweetness, delivering a smooth yet stimulating sensation.

Flavor Profile: Citrus: fresh lemon-lime, and orange notes,

offering an immediate burst of tangy freshness that awakens the palate.

Tropical: Juicy pineapple, ripe mango, and an exotic

tropical punch creates a smooth, fruity sweetness with a refreshing, beachy

finish.

Experience: Baja Blast transports you to a tropical escape

with every puff, delivering an uplifting cerebral rush that enhances your mood

while a deeply soothing body high eases away tension. Its smooth, fruity finish

ties it all together, making each inhale feel like a refreshing escape.

Ideal For: Perfect for those seeking a mental boost and a

sense of euphoria, Baja Blast is great for daytime use. Whether you're sparking

creativity, enjoying social moments, or simply need a burst of energy, this

vape keeps you sharp, uplifted, and ready for adventure.

864.desc:
Capture the essence of a perfect Jersey Shore getaway where the sweet and tangy combination of blue raspberry and lemonade transports you to sun-soaked shores. This vibrant, fruity blue raspberry flavor shines through, perfectly balanced by a burst of zesty lemonade for a refreshingly unique twist on the classic.

Flavor Profile: Blue Raspberry Lemonade: A blend of tart, freshly squeezed lemonade and the sweet-tart goodness of juicy blue raspberries, creating a mouthwatering, candy-like flavor that’s both bold and refreshing.

Citrus: A hint of lemon adds a zesty zing, enhancing the blue raspberry for an extra kick of citrusy refreshment.

Experience: Beach Day Lemonade delivers an uplifting, mood-boosting high that keeps you energized and carefree. Perfect for boardwalk strolls, beach days, or any sun-soaked adventure, it’s your go-to for the ultimate summer vibes.

Ideal For: Those seeking a burst of summer energy and a carefree, uplifting vibe. Perfect for daytime adventures whether you're chasing sunsets, or simply basking in that laid-back, vacation state of mind.

Let Beach Day Lemonade transport you to sun-soaked shores where every hit brings a refreshing, feel-good experience.

865.desc:
Mango: Succulent and sweet, bursting with tropical juiciness that instantly transports you to summer afternoons under the sun.

Citrus Zest: A refreshing hint of tangy citrus that balances the sweetness and adds a lively sparkle to the flavor.

Experience: Mangonada delivers a euphoric, uplifting head high paired with a smooth, mellow body buzz. It’s perfect for sparking creativity, keeping good vibes flowing, or adding a splash of tropical sweetness to your day.

Ideal For: Sunny afternoons, social sessions, and anyone who craves fruity, refreshing flavors. Whether you’re chasing creative sparks or simply looking to brighten your mood, Mangonada brings the taste of Mexico’s favorite mango treat to every puff.

869.desc:
Experience the intensity of Drool's Solventless THC Diamonds - pure, potent, and crafted without solvents for the cleanest possible hits. Each diamond delivers high-THC concentration, rich full-spectrum flavor, and smooth vapor, making it the ultimate choice for those who demand both power and purity.

Alaskan TF is a bold sativa known for its electrifying uplift and crisp, earthy-sweet flavor. Originating from the Matanuska Valley, it delivers a clear-headed, energetic buzz that sparks creativity and focus-perfect for powering through the day with a smile.

870.desc:
Lemon Skunk is a popular sativa-dominant hybrid strain known for its zesty, pungent lemon and earthy skunk flavors. It typically provides fast-hitting, energizing, and euphoric effects, making it an excellent choice for daytime productivity and stress relief. 

When this strain is crafted into rosin vapes, you get a premium, solventless experience. Live rosin is made using only ice water, heat, and pressure to extract the plant’s trichomes, meaning no harsh chemicals or solvents are involved. This method beautifully preserves Lemon Skunk's natural terpene profile.

871.desc:
Bahama Mama from Ozone is a tropical, sativa strain bred by crossing Black Banana x Tropicana Cookies. Consumers are welcomed with an aroma and flavor profile of passionfruit, ripe banana, and sour citrus oranges with a smooth berry exhale. Effects reported include mental clarity, motivation and inspiration, making it ideal for wake and bakes and daytime use!

The NEW Ozone 1g PIXI Disposable Vape is a sleek, compact, and high-performance vaping device designed for those seeking a premium, hassle-free experience. Pre-filled with 1 gram of premium cannabis distillate, the PIXI delivers smooth, consistent hits with every puff. It's discreet, lightweight design makes it perfect for on-the-go use, while its rechargeable battery ensures long-lasting enjoyment. Whether you're a seasoned enthusiast or new to vaping, the Ozone PIXI offers a reliable and enjoyable way to experience your favorite strains with ease. Convenient, portable, and high quality - Ozon's PIXI disposable vape is the ideal choice for a premium vaping experience.

872.desc:
Uncle Larry is a vibrant sativa celebrated for its bright, citrus-forward aroma intertwined with subtle herbal and pine notes. Its visually striking buds glisten with a coat of sparkling trichomes, promising a refined sensory experience.

The effects deliver a clear, euphoric cerebral uplift that inspires creativity and enhances focus, making Uncle Larry perfect for daytime use, social engagements, or any activity that benefits from mental clarity and energy. This strain balances invigorating stimulation with a gentle body ease to keep users motivated without overstimulation.

873.desc:
The Mule Extracts Apricot Jelly Dank Tank is a popular sativa-dominant, all-in-one rechargeable live resin disposable vape.

Sensory Profile: A pungent mix of sweet apricot jam and orange marmalade on the inhale, finishing with a rich, doughy, and gassy cannabis exhale.

The Experience: A Sativa-dominant hybrid that delivers a swift, clear-headed energetic rush and boosts creativity/focus. It is balanced by smooth physical relaxation without causing racing anxiety or couch-lock.

The Science: Made from 100% pure live resin with high terpene counts (around 5.6%), heavily featuring Limonene for mood elevation and Myrcene for smooth body effects.

874.desc:
Passion.Orange.Guava.

The Mule Extracts P.O.G. Boost FXT 2g disposable is a potent, high-energy sativa vape designed to deliver an uplifting and clear-headed daytime experience. Utilizing a Full-Spectrum Extraction (FXT) process, it preserves a robust cannabinoid and terpene profile, that ensures a smooth, long-lasting high with minimal crash. Its flavor and aroma profile is deeply tropical, serving a sharp, sour burst of zesty orange and passionfruit on the inhale, rounded out by a sweet, smooth pink guava finish on the exhale. Driven by dominant terpenes like mood-elevating Limonene and anti-inflammatory Beta-Caryophyllene, the "Boost" formula is highly euphoric, making it an excellent choice for sparking creativity, fighting daytime fatigue, and elevating focus, though sensitive users should dose mindfully to avoid potential sativa-induced anxiety.

875.desc: The Simply Herb Tropicana Diesel 1G Disposable is an all-in-one distillate vape pen known for its bright, fuel-forward, and tangy citrus profile. A cross between Sour Diesel and Tropicana Cookies, this sativa-dominant hybrid delivers a lively balance of energizing, euphoric effects alongside deeply relaxing undertones.

876.desc:
Tangie is sativa dominant hybrid strain known for its sought-after citrus profile. Offering consumers a potent flavor and mirroring aroma of bright citrus, sweet tangerine peel, crisp orange, and sour skunk on the exhale. Its strong citrus profile is known for acting fast, providing a euphoric cerebral buzz, a boost of energy, clarity and physically grounding you. This makes it ideal for those who have a long day ahead of them! Perfect for a wake and bake and a sesh with friends.

Ozone Reserve live resin disposable vapes capture the essence of cannabis flower in its truest form, with strains cultivated and harvested to carefully preserve the delicate balance of terpenes. We extract under only ideal conditions from a single source of plant materials – no extraneous flavorings or terpene additives. A clean and convenient pocket-size option.

877.desc:
The Offshore Oil Co. Dragon Fruit 1g is a Sativa-Hybrid disposable vape cartridge containing concentrated cannabis oil. It is pre-filled and pre-charged, featuring an attached battery designed for discreet, on-the-go inhalation.

The Scent: The initial aroma is a clean, exotic blend of sweet tropical fruit and soft melon.

The Flavor: Upon inhalation, you will experience a smooth, natural sweetness that mimics ripe pear and tropical dragon fruit, rounded out by subtle floral, creamy, and herbal undertones on the exhale. It avoids tasting overly artificial or overpowering.

Initial Rush (Uplifting & Cerebral): It starts with a fast-acting wave of euphoria, mental energy, and creative focus. Many users report feeling exceptionally happy, giggly, and talkative, making it great for social settings or daytime tasks.

The Plateau (Calm & Relaxing): As the high settles, the physical effects balance out into a grounded, calm body relaxation. It helps soothe everyday physical stress and ridding the mind of racing thoughts without inducing heavy sedation or couch-lock.

878.desc:
The pursuit of the golden hour inspired this uplifting, tropical flavor. Fresh, juicy watermelon and ripe strawberry blend seamlessly with notes of warm coconut. A refreshing twist on a colada (without the piña).

ABOUT THE HARDWARE: The H-bar hardware is USB-C rechargeable and has a window for oil visibility. The compact design of the H-bar fits in the palm of your hand and can be comfortably placed in your pocket. Holiday distillate vapes are flavored with high-quality botanical terpenes.

879.desc: Maui Wowie is a classic sativa bursting with tropical citrus aromas and flavor. Known for its uplifting, happy effects, it’s the perfect strain for boosting your mood and bringing island vibes to any day. Only available for a limited time.

880.desc: The Lucky’s 1g Disposable Peach Mimosa is a convenient, all-in-one cannabis vape device that delivers a high-THC, Sativa-dominant hybrid experience. It combines potent distillate with live cannabis terpenes to create a sweet, tangy flavor profile rich in sugary peach, bright citrus, and subtle tropical notes. Designed for daytime use, it provides an energizing boost in creativity, mental focus, and motivation alongside a light, functional body relaxation. This pre-filled, one-gram disposable eliminates the need for separate batteries, making it a popular and easy-to-use choice for managing stress, fatigue, and mood swings on the go.

881.desc: The California Orange strain in the Mule Extracts Dank Tank delivers a vibrant aroma of freshly cut sweet oranges paired with subtle earthy, sweet-and-sour undertones. As a Sativa-dominant hybrid, it provides a highly uplifting and cerebral daytime high, boosting mood, creativity, and focus. Users can expect a clear-headed, happy buzz that motivates productivity, accompanied by a mild physical relaxation that soothes minor body tension without causing drowsiness or couch-lock.

882.desc: Chocolate Dubb from Ozone Reserve is a premium, sativa-dominant strain branching from the Sour Dubb family. Offering consumers a flavor packed profile of rich cocoa and nutty earthiness, balanced perfectly by a sour diesel on the exhale. This sativa provides an uplifting, fast-acting cerebral buzz that sparks creativity, energy, and a euphoric mental lift, making it ideal for productive afternoons, artistic tasks, or active daytime socializing! Ozone Reserve Live Resin cartridges capture the essence of the whole flower in its truest form.

883.desc:
Jack Herer
Super Skunk x Northern Lights x Haze

Jack Herer [orig: Super Skunk x Northern Lights x Haze] is a classic sativa with a sharp pine and citrus aroma accented by subtle sweetness.

884.desc:
Dawg Lemons, a crossing of Lemon Tree and Starwdawg, is known for its incredible taste, boasting intense flavors of citrus and a pine aftertaste that makes you feel like you're walking in a forest. The aroma alone is enough to get any connoisseur excited for a great session, as its zesty smell permeates through the room, filling the atmosphere with optimism and good vibes. Not only that, but it packs an uplifting and energetic buzz, leaving users feeling energized and focused with its light mental stimulation.

The moment you take your first puff of Dawg Lemons, your creative juices start to flow and the ideas begin to come. Every sense seems heightened, as you are drawn into a blissful state of motivation. You suddenly find yourself getting lost in thoughts and moments of clarity, each one more potent than the last. As the uplifting high radiates through your body and your mind, you feel ready to take on anything that comes your way.

Whether you're trying to finish a project, have an engaging conversation, or simply let your creativity fly free, Dawg Lemons provides the spark that will bring your imagination to life. Its heady effects create a dynamic atmosphere for innovation and exploration, allowing you to delve deep into the realm of creativity. For a blissful and inspiring journey, Dawg Lemons will surely be the fuel you need to get you there.

Strain Type: Sativa Hybrid

Lineage: [Lemon Tree] x [Stardawg]

Breeder: Green Point

Terpene Profile: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Linalool, Myrcene, Ocimene, Pinene, Terpinolene

Top Reported Strain Effects: Aroused, Creative, Energetic, Euphoric

Top Report Strain Flavors: lemon-scented cleaning solution, diesel fuel, pine, and soil

885.desc:
Philly Flyers Exclusive, Only at Brotherly Bud

Fly High takes our Chem Butter live resin and gives it the Flyers treatment, available exclusively at Brotherly Bud. This hybrid comes from a Chemdog OG and Peanut Butter Acai cross, delivering an energetic, creative lift alongside a euphoric, tingly body feel. The flavor runs layered and complex: sweet berry and herbal clove up top, with a savory butter finish and a sharp diesel edge underneath.

100% pure live resin. No filler, no Bullsh*t. Loaded into Cheetah's top-of-the-line rechargeable disposable, built with a proprietary V-tank so every drop of oil actually gets used. The dual chamber air tank keeps clogging out of the picture, and the Biobaleen module cuts spit back by 99%. A rink-ready pick for fans who want flavor and energy in the same pull.
